proposal.description: At the end of a step window the cycle counter wraps to 1 instead of 0, counting the wrapping cycle as the first of the next window, so every window after the first is one switching cycle short.
proposal.reason: In S_SS with cycles_per_step >= 2, the second and later ceiling steps on max_on_counts come every cycles_per_step-1 PWM cycles instead of every cycles_per_step, so SS_done is reached early. With cycles_per_step = 1 the counter leaves the terminal value 0 and has to wrap through its whole range, so the ramp stalls after its first step.

proposal.description: The SS_done look-ahead on a ramp step tests the current ceiling instead of the value about to land, so the last step does not raise SS_done itself.
proposal.reason: When the last ramp step brings max_on_counts up to max_on_limit, SS_done goes high one clock late, on the next clock through the at-target branch, instead of on the same clock as the step.

before: // Hold: ceiling and SS_done keep their values for all of S_RUN.
after: // Hold: ceiling and SS_done keep their values for all of S_RUN.
proposal.description: In S_RUN SS_done is treated as a live 'ceiling at target' status and recomputed against max_on_limit, instead of being held as the latched end of the ramp.
proposal.reason: If the host raises max_on_limit above the held ceiling while run_active is high, SS_done drops to 0 in S_RUN although the ramp finished and the ceiling is still being held.

proposal.description: The step-window counter only runs while a ramp step is still owed, not on every switching cycle of S_SS as the design says, so it freezes once the ceiling reaches the target.
proposal.reason: In S_SS after the ceiling reaches max_on_limit, the window counter stops. If max_on_limit is then raised while ss_active is still high, the next step on max_on_counts comes at a different PWM cycle from the original, where the window kept counting.
